waterMaskIdentity: each output chunk roundtrips the exact projected official WBM bytes; no land threshold, smoothing, erosion, connected-component deletion or mask LOD
coastlineAndIsletLimit: 1 arc-second source and nearest 30m reprojection cannot guarantee sub-cell rocks or shorelines. Retained tiny source components must not be discarded by renderer triangle masks.
gzipTransportOnly: gzip wraps shared-basis coefficients and necessary residuals, not a claim of procedural terrain synthesis
